features: Retry unconfirmed administrator requests with native Windows error 1223 indefinitely after each 30 second pause
Log the unconfirmed request, affected operation and attempt number; retry only elevation
Preserve native Win32 errors through direct .NET Process.Start with UseShellExecute and runas
Explicit cancellation during retry pauses through a validated per-run marker and wizard control
Keep other launch failures, elevated operation failures and reboot code 3010 distinct
limitations: Windows PowerShell 5.1/Forms and real UAC consent, cancellation, timeout and retry require physical Windows testing
No and a non-confirmed request can share ERROR_CANCELLED 1223; use the wizard cancellation control during the pause to stop retries
